content.simple_explanation: 'Clothes — How Things Are Made' is studied by first understanding the main idea, then noticing the evidence, examples and relationships in the chapter.
study_steps: Explain them in your own words.
key_points: Patterns with Threads Look closely around you.
Do you see birds building nests or spiders spinning webs?
Nature is full of hidden artists — animals, birds and insects who weave, stitch, design, and even glue things together.
Did you know we have a hidden artist around us who has been weaving long before humans ever did?
